regional_scope.population_reference_label: Haidian permanent residents at the end of 2024
regional_scope.scope_boundary: Haidian district population reference envelope; the package geometry remains a provisional Jing-Zhang analytical boundary
regional_scope.interpretation: This is a population-scale stress test and coverage guard, not an observed workforce count, census microdata release, or calibrated Haidian origin-destination matrix.

optimization_objective.satisfaction_boundary: Synthetic satisfaction proxy from time, reliability, accessibility and conflict; actual resident satisfaction remains unknown until survey/intercept evidence.
optimization_objective.service_unit_ledger: Each mode declares a synthetic service unit (train departure, bus departure, bicycle slot, accessible-path slot, car vehicle-equivalent or enterprise shuttle vehicle). Required units and vehicle/service kilometres are derived from assigned person trips; they are not observed fleet, timetable or capacity facts.

optimization_search.interpretation: The selected policy is a synthetic candidate from a declared finite policy set; capacity gates prevent a paper-optimal but overloaded mode from winning, and the result is not a calibrated local optimum until OD, capacity, accessibility and satisfaction observations replace the assumptions.

scenario_definitions.description: O1 service and reliability assumptions used as the comparable nominal screen.
Metro reliability and time are degraded while ground fallback remains available.
Bicycle and walking conditions deteriorate; no air candidate is opened to fill the gap.
Declared service capacity is temporarily reduced across modes to screen spare-capacity fragility.

robustness_screen.interpretation: This is a transparent robustness screen over declared synthetic perturbations. It does not prove local resilience or select an implementation policy; a failure is a stop-and-calibrate signal, and the selected nominal candidate remains provisional until dated disruption, weather, capacity, accessibility and behavioural evidence are available.
calibration_required: dated metro and bus disruption logs
weather and bicycle service cancellation records
mode and station capacity by 15-minute slice
observed fallback acceptance and recovery time
